name: Tristate Electronic Manufacturing
old_description: Tristate Electronic Mfg. Inc. is a privately owned, small business, providing Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) across a multitude of industries. Industries served are Health/Medical, Aerospace/Defense, Industrial/Instrumentation, RF/Microwave, and Communications. Established in 1985, Tristate is located in Western Maryland with close proximity to the Greater Baltimore/Washington metropolitan area.
about:
Tristate Electronic Manufacturing was founded in 1985 by Ryan Null in Boonsboro, Maryland. Null, a graduate of the Arundel Institute of Technology, began the business in his home basement before moving to a facility on Old National Pike. In 1990 the company relocated to its current site in the Washington County Business Park near Hagerstown, positioning it within 70 minutes of two major airports and at the intersection of I‑70 and I‑81. The privately owned small business has remained under the same ownership since its inception.

The company provides electronic manufacturing services (EMS) for original equipment manufacturers, offering high‑speed surface‑mount and through‑hole circuit board assembly at low, medium, and high volumes. Capabilities include micro‑BGA placement down to 0.2 mm pitch, QFN/QFP/01005 component handling, pin‑and‑paste, automated paste and epoxy dispensing, turnkey and consigned‑kit supply‑chain management, new‑product‑introduction prototyping through production, box‑build and mechanical assembly, functional and environmental testing, HiPOT, IC programming, X‑ray inspection, automated optical inspection, conformal coating, and flying‑probe testing via third‑party partners. The facility operates under ESD controls per ANSI/ESD 20.20.

Tristate serves OEMs in health/medical, aerospace/defense, industrial/instrumentation, RF/microwave, communications, aviation, commercial, and government sectors. Its customer base spans technology firms that require ITAR‑registered, DFARS‑compliant manufacturing with ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 quality systems.

The company emphasizes agile, lean operations that enable quick reaction and customized solutions; a workforce with an average tenure of 14 years that brings deep experience across technology cycles; a culture of integrity and straightforward communication; and a strategic location that simplifies regional logistics. Ongoing investment in workforce development keeps the team current with ISO, IPC, and industry standards.

name: Tru-Tronics Intl
old_description: Tru-Tronics International was founded in 1997 and has emerged as a leader in assisting purchasing departments with all of their board level components needs. Whether it’s solving problems with shortages, factory allocation, or discontinued parts, your Tru-Tronics sales representative is eager to help you with all of your purchasing needs.
about:
Tru-Tronics International operates from North Las Vegas, Nevada, where it was founded in 1996 as an assembly contractor specializing in electronic printed circuit assemblies, mechanical wire harnesses, and wire-wrap assemblies. The company has grown into one of the Las Vegas Valley’s providers of advanced assembly services.

Its core manufacturing services include custom and molded cable assemblies, printed circuit board assembly using both through-hole and surface-mount technology, box-build integration, conformal coating, chip and device programming, and RoHS conversion or compliant production. The facility supports small to high-volume, high-mix runs and offers both consignment and turnkey manufacturing models.

The company serves military contractors and subcontractors, OEMs, and electronic development projects, leveraging a Department of Defense registration and a military cage code. It also assists purchasing departments with board-level component needs, supplying obsolete and discontinued parts alongside a large in-stock inventory.

Tru-Tronics emphasizes a knowledgeable sales staff with decades of experience, on-time delivery with just-in-time scheduling, engineering and technical support, and lean manufacturing processes. Environmental practices such as ODS/VOC elimination and scrap recycling reflect its stated commitment to employee health and safety.

about:
Two In One Manufacturing, Inc. operates from Nashua, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 1989 as a wire harness assembly business. The company is woman- and minority-owned, located in a HUBZone with small disadvantaged business status.

As a sub-contract manufacturer, the firm provides engineering and manufacturing assembly services across two divisions: General Assembly, Precision Assembly, Military Class Production, and Cables Production. It employs approximately 75 full-time manufacturing workers in a facility that includes 35,000 square feet of production space, 4,500 square feet of storage, and 1,700 square feet of office and cafeteria area. The operation handles high-mix, low-to-high volume work with lead times ranging from one day to four weeks, supported by a flexible supply chain and kanban capabilities.

The customer base spans automotive, industrial renewable energy, military defense and homeland security, medical, aerospace, RF microwave assemblies, telecommunications, instrumentation, semiconductor, and industrial equipment sectors. Clients range from companies whose products are too complex for smaller contract manufacturers to those whose volumes fall below the thresholds of large overseas providers, as well as customers needing early-stage collaboration on new product development.

The company emphasizes continuous improvement and customer satisfaction, citing full transparency and open communication from quote through delivery. Its quality policy targets on-time delivery of quality products at competitive prices, with ISO 9001:2015, ITAR registration, IPC compliance, and RoHS compliance underpinning its processes.

about:
United Electronic Industries (UEI) was founded in 1990 in Norwood, Massachusetts. The company began with ISA bus data acquisition boards and expanded to PCI and PXI boards in the mid-1990s. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

UEI designs and manufactures PC/Ethernet data acquisition (DAQ) and control systems, data loggers/recorders, programmable automation controllers (PACs), and Modbus TCP solutions. The product line includes over 90 I/O boards covering analog input/output, digital I/O, serial/CAN, counter/timer, avionics, simulation, and power supply functions. All hardware is developed and manufactured in the United States.

UEI serves industries including nuclear energy, commercial and military aviation, space, oil and gas, commercial and military automotive, ship/submarine, energy/utilities, rail/transportation, and scientific research. Applications span hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, health and usage monitoring (HUMS), engine test, VISTAS ED-247, iDDS, simulators/trainers, cybersecurity, embedded control and logging, automated test, and distributed DAQ and control.

The company emphasizes a five-year standard warranty on all hardware, contrasting with typical one-year warranties. UEI states that its products are developed and manufactured entirely in the U.S., and it participates in the E-Verify program. Supported programming environments include C/C++, LabVIEW, MATLAB, Simulink, C#, Python, .NET, VB.NET, and LabWindows/CVI.

name: United Tool & Mold Inc
old_description: Founded on the principles of “Keeping the Plastics Industry Running,” UTM is your one-stop shop for all mold-servicing needs. Your downtime is our downtime.Our focus is to get you back into production fast.
about:
United Tool & Mold Inc. was founded in 1995 in Liberty, South Carolina, with a second strategic location in Rainbow City, Alabama. The company was established on the principle of "Keeping the Plastics Industry Running" to serve as a one-stop shop for mold-servicing needs, focusing on reducing customer downtime through rapid response and comprehensive repair capabilities.

The company provides repair and engineering change services for plastic injection and blow molds, operating a 60,000-square-foot facility in Liberty. Its capabilities include laser welding, large precision machining, massive mold fitting presses, and an 80" x 40" x 40" fluidized bed for cleaning mold components and hot runners. United Tool & Mold also offers on-site service with fully stocked vans for in-press repairs, preventive maintenance, and 24-hour emergency response. Engineering changes are performed using CAD platforms such as CATIA V4, V5, and Unigraphics, and the company manages new tool build projects through domestic and global sources.

United Tool & Mold serves the plastic injection molding and blow molding industries. Its customer base includes automotive suppliers such as Draexlmaier, which has cited the company's ability to complete most repairs within one or two days and provide reliable outside tool support.

The company differentiates itself through around-the-clock availability, on-site service that travels to the customer's facility, and engineering change lead times described as better than the industry average. Its founding philosophy centers on treating mold service as a partnership: "When you buy a tool from us, you're not purchasing a mold – you're purchasing a plastic part. You're buying our service."

name: United poly systems
old_description: Atkore, a publicly traded company with nationwide coverage, has been around since 1959 and helps companies meet these challenges. With our experience in manufacturing HDPE conduit and accessories, Atkore is your trusted telecom partner.
about:
United Poly Systems was established in 2011 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, by founders Jim Massengale and Bert Bridges, who brought over 40 years of combined industry experience. The company began with two HDPE pipe production lines and expanded to four by 2013. A second state-of-the-art manufacturing facility opened in Albuquerque in 2015, and four additional lines were added across both plants over the following four years. In June 2022, Atkore, Inc. (founded 1959, based in Harvey, IL) acquired United Poly Systems, and the business has since been acquired by Infra Pipe Solutions.

The company manufactures high- and medium-density polyethylene (HDPE/MDPE) pipe and conduit in diameters from 3/4-in. to 26-in. IPS, 4-in. to 24-in. DIPS, and 3/4-in. to 2-in. CTS. Operations span multiple plants across Allendale, SC; Thomasville, GA; Springfield, MO; Albuquerque, NM; Lovelady, TX; Dallas, TX; and Woodburn, OR. In its first decade, United Poly Systems produced over 120,000 miles of pipe. The manufacturing process includes resin quality inspections (cleanliness, carbon black content, melt flow index, density), dimensional testing (diameter, wall thickness, eccentricity, ovality, out-of-round), and tensile property testing (elongation at break, ring tensile burst, quick burst). Products are available in 12 colors with custom striping, packaged in reels, sticks, or coils, and can be customized with ribbed interiors, pull tape, or lubricated interiors.

United Poly Systems serves the broadband and telecommunications, power and communications, oil and gas, and energy utility markets. Customers include telecommunications contractors, broadband providers such as Foothills Broadband, utility district contractors, and electrical/high-voltage infrastructure projects. The company’s product suites — Comm-Line™, MicroPath™, Power-Line™, Pro-Line™, Sleeve-It!™, Hard-Line™, and Cable-in-Conduit — are designed for communications conduit, microduct, electrical conduit, large-diameter PVC replacement, and cable-in-conduit applications.

The company emphasizes its agile business model, coast-to-coast manufacturing footprint that reduces freight costs and lead times, and compliance with the Buy American Act for domestic sourcing. Its quality program covers resin, dimensional, and burst testing to UL, NSF, AWWA, and ASTM standards.

name: Universal Plastic Mold UPM, Inc.
old_description: For more than 60 years, Universal Plastic Mold has been a leading manufacturer of high tonnage custom and large part injection molding thanks to our one-stop facility. We want to provide a single, convenient source for your injection molding needs. Thanks to our diverse array of plastic injection molding equipment, our company can handle all of your plastic injection molding needs. We’ve mastered putting together a complete plastics manufacturing strategy, and our goal is to go far beyond making plastics.
about:
Universal Plastic Mold (UPM) is a family-owned custom plastic injection molder founded in 1962 in Baldwin Park, California. The company has operated continuously under family ownership, with second-generation leadership in place since 2007.

UPM operates 30 injection molding machines ranging from 150 to 2,000 tons, including five presses at 1,500+ tons and three at 2,000 tons, in a single ~130,000 sq ft facility. The company provides full turnkey scope — molding, finishing (painting, silk-screening, hot-stamping), complex assembly, PCB integration, kitting, packaging, and distribution — under one ISO 9001:2015 quality system. Approximately 300 employees and $30M+ annual revenue.

UPM serves mid-market OEMs in automotive, specialty vehicles, industrial, high-end electronics, medical and laboratory equipment, and packaging, with selective consumer goods and hardware work. Customers include OEMs running hard-tooled production programs with minimum economic runs of 500 pieces per release through annual volumes in the millions.

The company emphasizes single point of accountability — the Account Manager and Program Manager are the same person — a 24-hour email reply standard, and published performance metrics (99.33% on-time delivery, 5.4 DPMO, 98% customer retention). Domestic production keeps customer-owned tooling under U.S. jurisdiction, and first-pass DFM is provided at no additional cost.

Production uses FDA-approved materials with full traceability to source, and the company emphasizes that all items are made in the United States.

The company serves the pet-care industry, supplying retailers, distributors, and direct consumers with products designed for dogs, cats, and small animals. Its customer base includes pet owners seeking domestically produced, safety-focused items; testimonials highlight high-sided litter pans that reduce scatter and carriers that lessen travel anxiety.

Van Ness differentiates itself through its commitment to domestic manufacturing, material traceability, and an eco-friendly bamboo product line, positioning its offerings as higher-standard alternatives in the pet market.

old_description: Previously, he served as Vice President of Regulatory Affairs and Compliance Officer at Flexible Stenting Solutions, a subsidiary of Cordis Corporation. In this role, he executed various regulatory, quality, clinical and compliance duties that led to the Cordis acquisition in 2013. Before, Mr. Griffin founded Professional Catheter Corporation, where he served as President until the EP MedSystems acquisition in 1993.
about:
Vesper Medical, Inc. is a privately held medical device company based in Radnor, Pennsylvania. The company was formed in 2016 by Bruce J. Shook as a spinout of Intact Vascular, following Intact Vascular's acquisition by Royal Philips in 2020. Shook, a veteran medical device executive with over 30 years of experience, previously co-founded Neuronetics and served as president of Abiomed.

Vesper Medical develops a next-generation, modular venous stent portfolio designed to treat deep venous disease, specifically addressing anatomical challenges in the iliac and femoral veins. The platform allows physicians to customize therapy for a broad range of patient needs. The company operates with a leadership team spanning regulatory affairs, quality assurance, research and development, clinical affairs, and commercial functions, though facility size and production volumes are not publicly disclosed.

The company serves physicians and healthcare providers specializing in deep venous disease treatment, including interventional radiologists and vascular surgeons. Its scientific advisory board includes clinicians from institutions such as Christiana Care Health Services, St. Francis Hospital, Stanford University, and the University of Pennsylvania. Investors include New Enterprise Associates, Gilde Healthcare, Vensana Capital, and Quaker Partners.

Vesper Medical states its vision is a world free from the pain and disability associated with deep venous disease. Its core values are respect, integrity, innovation, quality, and patients first. The company was founded to advance the treatment of deep venous disease through uniquely engineered stent technology.

name: Veterans Trading Company, LLC
old_description: is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business. We provide a full range of integrated, end-to-end supply chain solutions and procurement support programs to commercial firms and Federal prime contractors.
about:
Veterans Trading Company (VTC) is headquartered in Ocala, Florida, where its primary Supplier Managed Inventory (SMI) facility operates, with additional presence across seven states. The company was founded in 2005 by a team of supply chain and industrial distribution veterans who set out to deliver the right product to the right location at the precise time it was needed. It is certified as a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business.

VTC provides integrated supply chain solutions and procurement support programs rather than manufacturing. Its core services include Supplier Managed Inventory (SMI) — covering purchasing, incoming inspection, solder and steam age testing, kitting, bulk breakdown, and value-added operations such as lead bending and trimming — as well as On-Site Procurement (OSP) and Customer Direct Procurement (CDP). The company also supplies a broad range of industrial MRO products.

VTC serves commercial firms and federal prime contractors, with a strong concentration in the aerospace and defense sectors. Its customer base includes major primes such as Lockheed Martin, The Boeing Company, Northrop Grumman, and BAE Systems, for whom it designs and manages supply chain models that reduce inventory and floor-space requirements.

The business was built on a “Best In Class” service principle that still drives its quality management system, which employs DMAIC Six Sigma methods across all processes. VTC highlights its ISO 9100:2015 and AS9100D certifications, its veteran-owned status, and a track record of industry awards for innovative supply chain models that deliver measurable productivity gains and cost savings.
